AcceptInvitationResult.description:
Mirrors `api.AcceptInvitationResult` — note `org_id` serializes as the
camelCase `orgId` (Go's json tag), unlike the snake_case elsewhere.
AcceptInvitationResult.title: AcceptInvitationResult

AdminBillingCatalogMigrationRun.description:
Go `AdminBillingCatalogMigrationRun` (field order preserved).
`created_by` and `metadata` are `omitempty` in Go.
AdminBillingCatalogMigrationRun.title: MigrationRunResponse

AdminBillingCatalogMigrationSample.description:
JSON shape of a migration sample (Go `AdminBillingCatalogMigrationSample`,
field order preserved). `current_stripe_price_id` is `omitempty` in Go.
AdminBillingCatalogMigrationSample.title: AdminBillingCatalogMigrationSample

AdminEnvironmentLifecycleJournalEntry.description:
Mirrors `api.AdminEnvironmentLifecycleJournalEntry`. The nullable text
columns are `COALESCE`d to `''` and serialized with `omitempty`
(dropped when empty); `metadata` is the raw jsonb (Go `COALESCE(...,
'null')` → `json.RawMessage`, so `null` when absent, never dropped).
`created_at` is a timestamptz formatted with Go's seconds-precision
`formatTime`. Bare-array body (no `$schema`).
AdminEnvironmentLifecycleJournalEntry.title: AdminEnvironmentLifecycleJournalEntry

AuditLogEntry.description:
Mirrors `api.AuditLogEntry`. `user_id`/`user_email`/`ip_address`/
`user_agent` are Go `*string` → serialize as `null` when absent;
`metadata` is `any` with `omitempty` → dropped when the JSONB column
is NULL. Bare-array body (no `$schema`).
AuditLogEntry.title: AuditLogEntry

AuthResponse.description:
Mirrors `auth.AuthResponse`. `skip_2fa_setup` is `omitempty` on the
Go side and the idp service has no `Skip2FASetup` config, so it is
always `false` here and omitted from the body.
AuthResponse.title: AuthResponse

BillingEventResponse.description:
Mirrors `responses.go::BillingEventResponse`; `metadata` is omitted when
NULL, like Go's `omitempty`.
BillingEventResponse.title: BillingEventResponse

subscriptions.description:
The Go handler never populates this; a Go nil slice marshals as
JSON null, so `None` here is the faithful encoding.

CreateAPIKeyResponse.description:
Mirrors `api.CreateAPIKeyResponse` (APIKey flattened + the one-time
raw key).
CreateAPIKeyResponse.title: CreateApiKeyResponse

CreateAdminBillingCatalogPlanInputBody.description:
Body for create + update. Numeric widths match the schema
(`integer` → `i32`, `double precision` → `f64`); the Go input uses
`int`/`float64`. All catalog plan fields are required by the generated
Rust schema and enforced by `ValidatedJson`.
CreateAdminBillingCatalogPlanInputBody.title: CreatePlanBody

hourly_breakdown.description:
Go appends to nil slices, so empty marshals as null — `None`
reproduces that exactly.

ExtendTTLInputBody.description:
Body of `POST .../extend-ttl`. (Go's huma schema also 422s when the
field is absent; the CLI always sends it, so only the in-range
check below is on the parity surface.)
ExtendTTLInputBody.title: ExtendTtlBody

GitHubStatus.description:
Mirrors `api.GitHubStatusOutput.Body` (huma serializes struct fields
in declaration order; the `omitempty`/pointer fields drop when empty).
GitHubStatus.title: GitHubStatus

OrgMember.description:
Mirrors `api.OrgMember`. `name`/`image` are Go `*string` with no
`omitempty` → serialize as `null` when absent (serde `Option` default).
`assignments` is `omitempty` → dropped when empty.
OrgMember.title: OrgMember

OrgWithMembers.description:
Mirrors `api.OrgWithMembers` — the embedded `api.Organization`
fields flattened (Go struct embedding) plus the member list. The optional
deletion fields allow mixed-version consumers during the asynchronous
deletion rollout.
OrgWithMembers.title: OrgWithMembers

OrgWithRole.description:
Mirrors `api.OrgWithRole` (Go embeds `Organization`, so the JSON is flat).
`assignments` is `omitempty`; `trial_ends_at` is `*string` with no
`omitempty` → `null` when absent.
OrgWithRole.title: OrgWithRole

OrganizationDeletionState.description:
Organization lifecycle state exposed while an asynchronous deletion is
retained. Successful deletion has no terminal enum value because the
organization then becomes `404 Not Found`.
OrganizationDeletionState.title: OrganizationDeletionState

SaveGitHubTokenBody.description:
Mirrors `api.SaveGitHubTokenInput.Body`. `access_token` is required; the
rest are `omitempty`. The two `*_at` fields are RFC3339 strings the handler
parses (best-effort, like Go's `time.Parse`).
SaveGitHubTokenBody.title: SaveGitHubTokenBody

SetupConfig.description:
Mirrors `api.SetupConfig` (stored as JSONB; all fields omitempty —
BTreeMaps keep key order sorted like Go's map marshaling).
SetupConfig.title: SetupConfig

SignInResponseBody.description:
Mirrors `SignInResponseBody` — `user`/`session` are `omitempty`
pointers, `twoFactorRequired`/`twoFactorToken` are `omitempty`. The
success branch sends `user`+`session`; the 2FA branch sends only
`twoFactorRequired`+`twoFactorToken`.
SignInResponseBody.title: SignInResponseBody

UpdateAdminBillingCatalogPlanInputBody.description:
Body for create + update. Numeric widths match the schema
(`integer` → `i32`, `double precision` → `f64`); the Go input uses
`int`/`float64`. All catalog plan fields are required by the generated
Rust schema and enforced by `ValidatedJson`.
UpdateAdminBillingCatalogPlanInputBody.title: PlanWriteBody

UpdatePresetBody.description:
Mirrors `api.UpdatePresetBody` (all-optional PATCH semantics; for
maps/slices "present" means replace, mirroring Go nil-vs-empty).
UpdatePresetBody.title: UpdatePresetBody
